name: publish-release
title_zh: 本地验完才交给门禁流水线的发版手
tagline_zh: 本地跑完测试和构建才推给 GitHub Actions 门禁，发布后自动回验 npm 包。默认 next 预览。
tagline_en: Runs local checks first, then hands off to the gated workflow, and verifies the npm tarball after. Defaults to.
desc_en: Release moi-computer to npm — verify locally, hand off to the gated GitHub Actions workflow, then verify the published package. Defaults to a `next` preview; pass `stable` for a `latest` release. Use when the user asks to publish, release, ship a version, or cut a dev preview.
why_zh: 把「发版」拆成三段：本地验证、门禁放行、发布后回验。每段都有明确失败点。
why_en: Splits release into three checkpoints: local verify, gated CI, post-publish verification. Each has a clear failure point, so a.
limit_zh: 只认 npm 发布流程，且仓库必须已配好 molefrog/moi 的 GitHub Actions 门禁。
limit_en: Only for npm publishing in repos with molefrog/moi's gated Actions already set up. No version bump, changelog, or git tag; ends at installable npm.
title_en: Publish that verifies locally, then hands to CI
